Class SmugglersCard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.galaxy_trucker.server.model.cards.Card
it.polimi.galaxy_trucker.server.model.cards.AbstractEnemy
it.polimi.galaxy_trucker.server.model.cards.SmugglersCard
All Implemented Interfaces:
CannonsHandlerCard, CargoHandlerCard, DecisionHandlerCard
public class SmugglersCard extends AbstractEnemy implements CargoHandlerCard
Represents a Smugglers enemy encounter card. In this combat event, players must meet a required cannon power to avoid punishment. If successful, the player is rewarded with cargo blocks. If defeated, the player loses cargo.

Implements cargo handling for both rewarding and punishing players.
